definitions.explanation: To stop trying or hoping for something; to accept that something cannot be achieved.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}を{諦|あきら}めないで。
examples.english: Don't give up on your dream.

examples.japanese: もう{諦|あきら}めました。
{簡単|かんたん}に{諦|あきら}めてはいけない。

notes:
{諦|あきら}める means to give up or resign oneself.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{諦|あきら}める: to give up on ~
- {諦|あきら}めずに: without giving up
- {諦|あきら}めが{悪|わる}い: reluctant to give up

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- やめる: to quit, stop
- {断念|だんねん}する: to give up (formal)
- 手を引く: to withdraw

Note: Ichidan verb (る-verb).
